hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.env|*.env.*) [ "${f##*/}" = ".env.example" ] || { echo 'Blocked: .env holds live ANTHROPIC/TAVILY/LANGSMITH keys. Read .env.example for the variable names.' >&2; exit 2; };; *uv.lock) echo 'Blocked: uv.lock is generated. Change dependencies with uv add / uv remove / uv sync.' >&2; exit 2;; esac; exit 0

c=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); printf '%s' "$c" | grep -qE '(^|[;&|] *)(pip3?|python3? +-m +pip) +(install|uninstall)|(^|[;&|] *)(poetry|conda|pipenv) +|python3? +-m +venv' && { echo 'Blocked: this project is uv-only (see CLAUDE.md). Use uv add / uv sync / uv run / uvx instead.' >&2; exit 2; }; exit 0

c=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""')
printf '%s' "$c" | grep -qE '\.env([^.A-Za-z0-9_-]|$)' || exit 0
printf '%s\n' "$c" | tr ';&|' '\n\n\n' | while IFS= read -r seg; do
  printf '%s' "$seg" | grep -qE '\.env([^.A-Za-z0-9_-]|$)' || continue
  printf '%s' "$seg" | grep -qE '^[[:space:]]*(cp|mv|ls|test|\[|touch|stat|file)([[:space:]]|$)' && continue
  exit 9
done
[ $? -eq 9 ] && { echo 'Blocked: reading .env would put live API keys into the transcript. Variable names are in .env.example; the app loads .env itself via load_dotenv() in config.py.' >&2; exit 2; }
exit 0
f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.py) uvx ruff format -q "$f"; uvx ruff check -q --fix "$f" || true;; esac; exit 0

f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/src/grant_writer/*.py|"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/tests/*.py) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; out=$(cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && uv run pytest tests/ -q --no-header -p no:warnings 2>&1) || { printf '%s\n' "$out" | tail -25 >&2; exit 2; }

f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.py) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; n=$(cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && uvx ty check src/ tests/ 2>&1 | grep -cE '^(error|warning)\['); [ "$n" -gt 2 ] && { echo "ty: $n diagnostics vs baseline 2 (both upstream in deepagents/langgraph, deliberately unsuppressed). You introduced $((n - 2))." >&2; exit 2; }; exit 0
